# TRL-TPL-0008: Template parameter is unknown or missing

- Severity: error
- Exit class: error
- Area: TPL
- Since: 0.1.0
- Status: active

## Remediation

Pass only declared parameters and supply every parameter that has no default.

## Example

```json
{"code": "TRL-TPL-0008", "severity": "error", "params": {}}
```
